facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation launched on 5 October 2026 a national local-languages challenge, first stage of the three-year Voix du Togo programme, collecting voice and text data (50 validated audio hours, 6,000 translated sentence pairs, 500 speakers per language) to train AI models, with a one-month pilot on Ewe, Kabye and Moba.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation
